rows.subject: Kubernetes parity target
rows.current_observation: Kubernetes/Prow are parity targets for API machinery, controllers, admission, conformance, and merge automation. They are not permanent product authority.
rows.next_action: Create source-tracked parity rows and first differential fixtures.

rows.subject: Linux ABI and OS/runtime parity
rows.current_observation: Linux userspace ABI, OCI/CRI, Kubernetes node, and sandbox/runtime references are mapped. Internal Linux kernel APIs are not stable contracts.
rows.next_action: Add neutral kernel/os capability registry placement and implement a narrow ABI/OCI parity harness lane.
